summary: This is a routine Form 6-K filing by United Microelectronics Corporation (UMC) announcing the date of a board meeting (April 29, 2026) to review its Q1 2026 consolidated financial report. The filing is a foreign issuer's notification of an upcoming board meeting and contains no financial results, transaction details, or special-situations event. It is equivalent to an announcement of a board meeting date under US reporting norms. As there is no acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, or other special situation involved, this filing is classified as 'None'.
